notes: Operational Oct 2026: Purple PCMC Bhavan–Swargate 13 stns (~17.4 km incl. unopened Range Hills); Aqua Vanaz–Ramwadi 16 stns (~14.66–15.7 km). District Court Pune is the only interchange (Purple/Aqua; Pink pending).
Colours: Purple #903373, Aqua #007CB0, Pink #F91C91 from Wikipedia Module:Adjacent stations/Pune Metro; Pink Line infobox uses #E7449A. Lines 4, 5 and HCMTR have no published colour (null).

Pink Line not opened as of latest reports (Sep 2026): CMRS cleared Maan–R K Laxman Museum Balewadi (12 stns, ~13 km) 2026-07-23; PMRDA planned to open 17 of 23 stations first (closed: Laxmi Nagar, Balewadi Phata, Baner Gaon, Baner, RBI, Shivajinagar), date depends on PM/CMO. Total 23.203 km per PMRDA; per-segment km not published.

Pink Line station names vary heavily between sources. Wikipedia's renamed list is used; press names e.g. Megapolis Society/Megapolis Circle (=Maan), Quadron Business Park, Dohler, Infosys Phase 2, Wipro Phase 2, Pall India, Shivaji Chowk, Courtyard by Marriott, Balewadi Stadium, Orchid Hotel, Ramnagar, High Street/Laxmi Nagar, Krushi Anusandhan, YASHADA, District and Sessions Court/Civil Court. Mapping between old and new names not fully verified.

Dec 2025 renames (single news source + Wikipedia): Nal Stop -> SNDT College, Ideal Colony -> Paud Phata, Mandai -> Mahatma Phule Mandai. Wikipedia also lists Budhwar Peth as Kasba Peth, Civil Court as District Court Pune, PMC as PMC Bhavan; treat as current Wikipedia names.
Purple km by section from Wikipedia Phase 1 table (5.87/8.03/3.33); Wikipedia line infobox says 16.59 km, network table 17.4 km.
Range Hills (between Khadki and Shivaji Nagar) still listed as under construction; trains pass through. Target date unknown.

Swargate–Katraj: originally 3 stations (Market Yard, Padmavati, Katraj); Bibwewadi and Balaji Nagar added via revised tender Apr 2025 (state-funded, +Rs 683 cr). TMRG also mentions 'Saibaba Nagar' for the middle station. Order of Bibwewadi/Padmavati/Balaji Nagar follows Wikipedia.
Nigdi extension official target Dec 2027 (MahaMetro MD, Apr 2026); TMRG blog says no sooner than 2029.

Line 2A/2B: Union Cabinet approved 2025-06-25 (12.75 km, 13 stns, Rs 3,626.24 cr, 4 years -> 2029). 2B marked approved (tenders/groundwork only, no confirmed civil award found). 2B terminus spelled Vitthalwadi/Vithalwadi/Vitthalawadi; Chandani/Chandni Chowk.

Line 4 numbering conflict: Wikipedia calls Khadakwasla–Kharadi 'Line 4' (4A Nal Stop–Warje–Manik Baug, 4B Hadapsar–Loni Kalbhor, 4C Hadapsar–Saswad Road); TMRG calls it 'Line-5' and 'Spur Line'; Wikipedia's 'Line 5' is Nigdi–Chakan. Year 2030 for Line 4/4A is inferred from 5-year completion in Nov 2025 approval.

Line 4 station names variants: Sant Nagar Chowk vs Sainath Nagar; Swargate vs Swargate North; Hingne vs Hingane; Pu La Deshpande Udyan vs Deshpande Udyan; Kolhewadi proposed as start (Aug 2026 reports). 4A: Wikipedia ends at SNDT (Nal Stop interchange); TMRG list starts Paud Phata; Dahanukar vs Dhunkar Colony.

Line 4B variants: one source lists Hadapsar Phata, Hadapsar Bus Depot, Akashwani-Hadapsar, Laxmi Colony, Stud Farm, Manjari Phata, Grape Growers' Association, Toll Naka, Wak Wasti, Loni Kalbhor (no Hadapsar Chowk). 4C 'Subhash Garden' vs 'Sulabh Garden'; Gliding Centre vs Glider Club. Official count: 4B 10 stns, 4C 4 new stns.

Line 5 Nigdi–Chakan: Wikipedia list (31 stns) is from an earlier 45.29 km DPR; revised plan is 40.926 km / 31 stns so list may have changed. 'Bhumar Chowk'/'Bhosairi' in Wikipedia corrected to Bhumkar/Bhosari; 'Bharatmata Chowk (Moshi)' parenthetical dropped.
HCMTR ring line: only source is TMRG; status/stage unverified; low confidence.
Older PMRDA idea of extending Line 3 from Civil Court to Hadapsar/Phursungi IT Park (~11.8 km, 12 stns) appears only in Wikipedia; no current status, not included as a segment.
n_stations = length of stations list (includes shared end/interchange stations), not the count of new stations.

Suburban rail: Central Railway Pune–Lonavala and Pune–Daund suburban/DEMU services run alongside; metro interchanges at Kasarwadi, Dapodi, Khadki, Shivaji Nagar, Pune Railway Station, and planned Akurdi, Chinchwad, Hadapsar.
